title: Molecularly engineered dual-network eutectogel electrolytes for high-loading and stable zinc–iodine batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02664H, Paper
Ling Wang, Jinpeng Guan, Na Li, Jing Li, Zhaoyu Wang, Jin Yin, Yi-Lin Liu, Maolin Yu, Yongbiao Mu, Zetao Chen, Yuwei Li, Jianxiong Xu, Lin Zeng
A molecularly engineered dual-network eutectogel regulates Zn2+ transport, water activity, and polyiodide chemistry, enabling long-life, wide-temperature, and stable high-loading Zn–I2 batteries.
